get.description: Premium Auth View

Returns a paginated list of all congress members and FEC-registered candidates with trading stats and net worth. Includes both seated members and candidates by default. Results can be sorted by name, trade count, trade volume, or net worth.

parameters.name: chamber
parameters.description: Filter by congressional chamber: house or senate (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: include_candidates
parameters.description: Include FEC-registered candidates who are not current congress members. Defaults to true. Set to false to return only seated members.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Filter by active/inactive status. Defaults to true for the live endpoint (only active members). Set to false to include all members.

parameters.name: party
parameters.description: Filter by party affiliation: Democratic, Republican, or Independent

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field for results. Accepted values: name (alphabetical, ascending), trade_count (descending), trade_volume (descending), net_worth (descending).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by US state (full name, e.g. California, Texas, New York)

parameters.name: volume_method
parameters.description: Method to estimate trade volume from disclosed amount ranges (e.g. '$1,001 - $15,000'). Accepted values: range_start (lower bound), average (midpoint, default), range_end (upper bound).
